name: Honestly
preview: You told me the same thing over a week ago, I was on chat for 4 hours with no reply.

messages.text: May I ask a question about the price match?
Sure, ask away. What's the price match question?
Bitcoin Merch® - NEXUS S1-2 - 10TH/s Home Miner w/ Power Supply, for 599.99 on another site, is this the same as yours?
Read the nexus s1 10th s page
Searched the catalog · NEXUS S1 10TH/s home miner

Honestly, I can't vouch for another shop's listing. Ours is the NEXUS S1 (10TH/s), $699, ~150W, 4x BM1373, Mean Well LRS-350-12 PSU and the 3D printed stand included. The "S1-2" name isn't a model we sell, so it may be a different revision or a different bundle, and that's usually where the price gap sits.

On price matching, I can't do it, our prices are as listed. If you want Georges to look at it himself, say the word and I'll pass it to him.
Please, it is on the https://bitcoinmerch.com/products/bitcoin-merch%C2%AE-nexus-s1-10th-s-home-miner-w-power-supply
Read the bitcoin merch page

I can't open that site from here, so I can't compare their listing line by line.

What I can tell you is what ours is: NEXUS S1, ~10 TH/s, ~150W, 4x BM1373, Mean Well LRS-350-12 power supply and the 3D printed stand, $699, US and UK plug in stock, EU not right now.

If their spec sheet matches that exactly, it's the same base hardware. The price itself I can't match, ours is as listed. Want me to put it to Georges?
I was giving you the site, so you could pass it on.
Handed to the team · price match / discount decision is not mine to make

Got it, thanks, I've passed the link and the $599.99 price to Georges for the price match decision.

The team is offline right now and picks it up Monday at 10am ET, and the answer comes to your email, so no need to wait here.
Yes, I know, same thing you have told me for over 2 weeks, and they have yet to get with me.

That's fair, and I'm sorry. Two weeks of being told someone will come back to you, and nobody has, is not good enough.

I've put this one in front of Georges with the link and the price, so it's his to answer. I won't promise you a date or an outcome I don't control.

If the DC02 firmware case is still open on your side too, tell me and I'll make sure that goes with it.
Yes, still have not heard anything on the DC-02 or the DC-04 issues.
Handed to the team · JD never came back on the DC02 locked-batch case; DC-04 issue also open and undo

Both are back in front of JD now, the DC02 locked-batch case with everything we established, and the DC-04 one alongside it.

Faster route while you wait: our Discord, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf. JD is there most days as @nullhashrate, Admin role. Post in the server and mention him, he answers hardware there quicker than email.

One thing I don't have, what exactly is going wrong with the DC-04? Tell me and I'll add it to the case tonight.

Sorry BC-04, it was supposed to come with Harlo OS on it and it did not and it will not let me install it, I have already talked to Hal, he was sending it to JD, I have also talked on the phone with Abel..
Handed to the team · correcting the model on my previous flag; case already seen by Hal and Abel with

Noted and corrected, BC04, shipped without Harlo OS and won't take an install. That's on the same case as the DC02s now, with Hal's hand-off and your call with Abel on the record.

One thing worth trying meanwhile: check the firmware version the BC04 reports in its web UI against the latest BC04 build on https://harlolabs.com/. If it's on an old stock build, that alone can block the install.

What version does it show?
On the Harlo site or the miner?

Both, but start with the miner.

Open the BC04's IP in a browser and read the version it reports in the UI. That tells us whether it's running stock Hammer firmware or Harlo OS already.

Then compare it with the newest BC04 release listed on harlolabs.com, so we know if you're simply behind.

Send me what the miner shows and I'll tell you which of the two you've got.
miner firmware 3.0.5 20260909

That's the stock Hammer firmware, not Harlo OS. Harlo versions read 0.x.xx or 2.x, never 3.0.5. Same build string your DC02s report.

So your BC04 did arrive without Harlo OS, exactly as you said, and that's now confirmed rather than assumed. I've got it on the case for JD.

Please don't push an image through the settings updater on this one either. Does the BC04 fail at the same point in the USB flasher, "unsupported command error" at Connecting?

Different error, it says there may be line noise or something like that, plus I have download both files from the Harlo site and it won't take it that way either.  I think Hal mentioned, slowing down the baud rate, but I never found out how to do it?
Used route to tech
Any word On what they are going to do?

I'm back on the order side of this.

No decision has come back to me yet, on the price match or on the two firmware cases, so I won't guess at one. Both are in front of the team and they're on now, so it's live rather than sitting over a weekend.

For the BC04 flashing itself, Discord is still the fastest road: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, post and mention @nullhashrate. He can walk the baud rate with you in real time.

Anything on the order side I can check meanwhile?
I have already sent it on Discord, I was hoping I would actually get some help.
Used the store-orders skill
Handed to the team · Hal has been through it twice and handed back; Discord post unanswered; customer

You're right to be annoyed, you've been round Hal, JD, Abel and Discord and still have nothing.

So I've stopped passing you along. This is now in front of JD and Georges as a decision on Shop····: the BC04 came on stock firmware, won't flash, and you also paid for the Harlo OS Diagnostics and RMA line on that same order. Fix it, or replace the unit.
